Expose only --fairness-engine and --prefill-compute-share through existing SchedulerConfig CLI construction; retain existing cadence argument.
Upstream weighted virtual-runtime controller with async in-flight reservations, measured-cost correction, and contention reset; no behavioral changes.
Only record_compute_time feedback contract; omit idle runtime switching APIs.
Only service-class and contention tags; preserve all baseline output fields.

Port compute-share selection and running-pass fallback onto installed scheduler. Preserve old allocation/lookahead/partial-prefill/LMCache recovery. Known in-flight remote-KV/grammar/streaming waits are not runnable prefill candidates until eligible. Mixed prefill-first batches charge their whole service quantum to prefill, as upstream. No micro-slicing, new draft-input budgets, Mamba ABI changes, or idle runtime switching.

configuration.async_scheduling: Retain baseline setting. With PP1, V2 async scheduling and V1 async scheduling both have two concurrent batches. The unchanged AsyncScheduler V2 next_decode_eligible_step=current_step+pp_size remains valid at PP1.
configuration.disable: Omit both --fairness-engine and --prefill-compute-share; restore original --prefill-schedule-interval value. No runtime switch endpoint is added.
configuration.share_domain: 0 < prefill_compute_share < 1; tuning without the explicit selector is rejected.
configuration.partial_prefill_semantics: Existing max_num_partial_prefills>=1, max_long_partial_prefills, and long_prefill_token_threshold semantics/defaults remain baseline. Upstream micro-slicing reinterpretation (zero=unlimited) is intentionally not imported.
configuration.runner_selection: PRESERVE THE PROVEN BASELINE V2 MODEL RUNNER SELECTION. Do not set VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=0 or launcher TUNE_VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=0. The actual GLM TP4/DCP4 partially replicated sparse-indexer KV requires V2. No runner-selection override is needed from this fairness layer.
configuration.required_target_runner: V2 model runner within the V1 engine

measurement.kind: model-service wallclock share (upstream), NOT pure accelerator-compute share
measurement.completion: Synchronous: after final model/sample result. Queued: callback on exact final model/sample Future, including deferred structured-output sampling.
measurement.charge: max(completed_at - max(started_at, previous_tagged_completion), 0). Only tagged contended nonempty batches reserve/charge service.
includes: sampling and MTP host dispatch before final result; asynchronous GPU tail completion is not guaranteed by a host result timestamp
host and device synchronization visible in the model-service interval
excludes: step-count cadence as a substitute for duration
transfer-only empty batches as prefill compute
measurement.mixed_batch: A prefill turn runs prefills first and can fill leftover capacity with decode; the entire measured quantum is charged to prefill, matching upstream.
measurement.measured_fraction: delta(prefill counter) / (delta(prefill counter) + delta(decode counter)); undefined if denominator is zero.

risks: No performance or startup-success claim: candidate and CPU validation script have not been executed by worker.

Host model-service timing is not accelerator-only time. Old MultiprocExecutor.FutureWrapper only consumes replies and invokes callbacks during result()/_wait_for_response(), not actual GPU completion or response arrival.
FIFO overlap subtraction only tracks timed contended batches, as upstream. Untimed in-flight work at contention transitions and deferred host grammar work can bias measured shares.
Mixed prefill/decode batches are attributed entirely to prefill; target is a service-quantum share, not an isolated per-kernel prefill/decode split.
Shared live clients and asynchronous LMCache lookup/restore readiness change contention, so HTTP TTFT/decode latency and throughput require independent controlled measurement.
Pure weighted-service pacing can change the number of graph shapes and effective batch composition. It does not guarantee latency or throughput gains.
DP/PP/PCP>1, DBO, custom schedulers, and non-MTP speculative methods are rejected rather than claiming unported ABI support.
Prometheus collection must remain enabled to observe charged service-time counters.
Actual target requires V2 due sparse-indexer DCP replication. Changing runner selection independently of fairness is unsafe and is not part of this layer.

v2_compatibility_review.conclusion: No worker/model-runner/attention/block-table changes are necessary for the target. Remove only the unsupported V1-only guard and runner-selection override; retain topology/DBO/speculative-method guards.
v2_compatibility_review.startup_failure_correction: Main reported fairness-off startup failed because the manifest forced V1 while partial sparse-indexer DCP replication requires V2. Do not reproduce that known failure. Baseline V2 selection must remain untouched.

source_evidence.finding: Partial sparse-indexer KV replication explicitly rejects non-V2 runner; DCP2..8/PCP1 and per-group CP tables are required.
At PP1, async V2 max_concurrent_batches=pp_size+1=2, identical queue depth to non-PP async V1.
Existing override calls parent advancement then maintains placeholders/spec tokens and next_decode_eligible_step=current_step+pp_size. Fairness still increments current_step exactly once.
Unchanged V2 branch merges resumed into new requests and passes full _all_token_ids as prefill_token_ids. Cached-request/V1 previous-step distinction is retained.
Persistent request slots are removed only for finished/preempted IDs. Scheduled subset maps into persistent state; batch sort normalizes decoder prefix order regardless of scheduler insertion order.
V2 uses the same execute_model(None)/sample_tokens(AsyncOutput) split; zero-token steps use kv_connector.no_forward. Timing wraps the unchanged final executor result ABI.
AsyncOutput subclasses AsyncModelRunnerOutput; get_output waits for its existing copy event and returns ModelRunnerOutput, consumed by unchanged executor output path.
Per-KV-group CP sizes and partially replicated DCP slot mapping remain baseline and independent of fairness tags.

v2_compatibility_review.independent_review: FairnessReview independently confirmed the same V2 PP1/MTP compatibility and zero-token connector recovery path to this worker.
